The flat locus is a subset of the target prime spectrum.

Each point of Spec(S) is a prime ideal q of S.
The stalk M_q is localization of the S-module M at S\q.
Flatness is the indexed module-theoretic property relative to the base ring.
The ring R_p is a localization of R at the complement of the prime p.
